mechanism: {{parsimony}}-Bounded Expansion. Limits the maximum number of parallel branches (fan-out) at any single node. Prioritizes branches by 'Distinctness' and 'Expected {{value}}'. If Candidates > Max_Breadth, applies Truncation (Top-K) or Clustering (merge similar branches). It enforces limits defined by {{budget}} during the {{decompose}} phase; candidate generation is upstream.
failure_modes: Fork Bomb: Unchecked decomposition creates exponential agent explosion.
Choice Overload: Too many weak hypotheses dilute the quality of the best ones.
{{context}} Fragmentation: Parent agent cannot integrate results from N > 7 children.
invariants: {{parallel}} branches are pairwise distinct under the declared distinctness metric.
Fan-out at a single node never exceeds `max_breadth`.

parameters.name: selection_strategy
parameters.description: How candidates are reduced: keep the best, or merge similar ones.
